walkthroughs.h2: Prove sum of two odd numbers is even
walkthroughs.body_html:
Let odds be 2m+1 and 2n+1

Sum = 2m+2n+2 = 2(m+n+1) This is 2k, so even

2 is prime 2 is even, claim disproved

walkthroughs.h2: Show (x-2) is a factor of x³-8

Let P(x)=x³-8

P(2) = 8-8 = 0 By factor theorem, (x-2) is a factor
